tips.title: Investigate failed CI
tips.text: CI has failed. Use this icon to ask this chat’s agent to investigate.

tips.title: Leave a review comment
tips.text: Select a line or drag across lines to leave a review comment.

tips.title: Send comments when ready
tips.text: Your comment is saved here. Send comments when you’re ready for the agent to address them, or include them in an agent review.

tips.title: Review across repositories
tips.text: Ask this chat to run your review skill. Its review can cover related repositories.

tips.title: A shell for this chat
tips.text: Open a shell in this chat’s working folder. Toggle it with {shortcut}.

tips.title: Ask Truffle
tips.text: Ask the app assistant for help finding work, changing settings, or using Truffle.

tips.title: Keep your tab bar clear
tips.text: This chat has been ready for at least three hours. Use the moon icon to snooze its tab and find it again in Snoozed chats.
